Package au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local.index

Class CodeSystemIndexes

java.lang.Object
au.csiro.pathling.terminology.local.index.CodeSystemIndexes
public final class CodeSystemIndexes extends Object
The runtime indexes for one code system version, loaded lazily per executor JVM from the store. The concept dictionary is loaded eagerly because it gates every other lookup; the hierarchy, reference set, and relationship indexes load on first use so a workload that only needs some of them does not pay for the others.
Author:
John Grimes
